description: The chart, Figure 16, illustrates the Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word, averaged over 247 tasks. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, labeled with relative positions, and are ordered sequentially from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Shapley values" and has a linear scale, ranging from approximately -0.02 to 0.08, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. Each bar corresponds to a relative position, with varying heights representing the Shapley values, and the tallest bar is at the target word position with a value of around 0.07, while the shortest bars are at the extreme left and right positions with values close to -0.02 and 0, respectively. The bars are colored uniformly and are not grouped or stacked, and they are not sorted in a specific order other than by relative position. No bars are visually emphasized.
